title: Brussels on split-screen: where it flexes – and where it bends
summary_full:
From a choreographed summit that dominated Westminster but barely registered in Brussels to a climate showdown in Turkey, last week revealed the EU’s priorities – and the limits of its collective power• Don’t get This Is Europe delivered to your inbox? Sign up hereTwo very different European diplomatic dramas played out almost simultaneously last week. On Friday, a tightly choreographed EU-UK summit transfixed London, while barely registering on the continent. On Sunday, Cop31 collapsed after a united EU forcefully vetoed a watered-down climate pact, even as it relaxed its own green rules at home.
 
 
 What do these two events reveal about the EU: how it works, what takes up its bandwidth, how it exercises its clout – and where it’s vulnerable?*** Continue reading...
